name: plrojek
description: Claude Code plugins by Paweł Rojek

plugins.name: garden-3d-viewer
plugins.description: Turn a planting plan into an interactive 3D garden in the browser: seasons, growth, real sun and shade, walk-through, shopping list. Static files, three.js, no build step.

plugins.name: sanalert
plugins.description: SanAlert's unofficial threat level from the air for Poland: the level for a place, worked out on your own computer, and the state of the whole country. Two MCP servers, no skill.

plugins.name: executor-guard
plugins.description: Hooks for agent sessions that execute a plan: no commits, merges or pushes on main, no force pushes to it, no git stash, no deploys without the user's OK, and a nudge to run the tests before stopping. Plus /handoff.

plugins.name: transcript-review
plugins.description: An accurate transcript with named speakers from a noisy recording with several people, on a Mac with Apple Silicon. Local models only, a review page where you correct a few passages by ear, voices matched from your corrections, doubtful words in italics.

plugins.name: pl-genealogy-record-search
plugins.description: Polish and former-Kresy genealogy: match a family tree against Geneteka, the Soviet deportation index, cemetery registers and scanned parish books, grade each finding, and patch the GEDCOM so it still imports.

plugins.name: app-store-motion-banners
plugins.description: App Store product-page header videos that work on an iPhone: nothing under the Dynamic Island or the store's buttons, real UI pieces from your screenshots moving where the phone shows the banner, a seamless loop rendered frame by frame, checked, and copied under 10 MB for upload.
